name: ネオン・サーキット
css: .roulette-wrapper { width: 480px !important; height: 480px !important; position: absolute !important; top: 260px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); margin: 0 !important; z-index: 10; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0,0,0,0.8) 20%, rgba(0,0,0,0.95) 100%); border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid rgba(255, 0, 85, 0.3); box-shadow: 0 0 20px #000; }
.canvas-container { position: absolute; top: 260px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 580px; height: 580px; z-index: 50; pointer-events: none; border-radius: 50%; }
canvas#webgl-canvas { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; border-radius: 50%; }

.pointer { position: absolute; top: 15px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 0; height: 0; border-left: 20px solid transparent; border-right: 20px solid transparent; border-top: 50px solid #FF0055; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px #FF0055); z-index: 60; }

.center-hub { position: absolute; top: 260px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 90px; height: 90px; background: #000; border: 3px solid #FF0055; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 15px #FF0055, inset 0 0 20px rgba(255, 0, 85, 0.3); z-index: 60; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; pointer-events: auto !important; cursor: pointer; -webkit-app-region: no-drag; transition: transform 0.1s, box-shadow 0.2s; }
.hub-content { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; pointer-events: none; }
.hub-text { font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; font-weight: bold; font-size: 16px; color: #FFFFFF; text-shadow: 0 0 5px #FF0055; letter-spacing: 1px; }
.center-hub:hover { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.1); box-shadow: 0 0 30px #FF0055, inset 0 0 30px rgba(255, 0, 85, 0.6); border-color: #FFFFFF; }
/* ▼▼▼ 修正: 位置を 600px に統一 ▼▼▼ */

#result { position: absolute !important; top: 600px !important; left: 0 !important; width: 100% !important; transform: none !important; text-align: center !important; font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 40px; font-weight: 900; color: #FFFFFF; z-index: 100; padding: 0; margin: 0; border: none; background: transparent; }

#legend-area { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9) !important; border: 1px solid #FF0055 !important; color: #FFF !important; font-family: 'Courier New', monospace !important; box-shadow: 0 0 10px #FF0055; }
